meta.name: offensive-business-logic
meta.description: Business logic vulnerability testing for web/mobile/API engagements. Covers workflow bypass, state machine violations, multi-step process abuse, price/quantity/discount manipulation, currency confusion, coupon stacking, refund/chargeback abuse, race conditions on logic boundaries, parameter tampering for hidden flows, role/tenant boundary violations, time-of-check vs use, anti-automation defeat, fraud-detection evasion, and subscription/quota abuse. Use when scoping an application after surface-level OWASP Top 10 has been covered, or when the asset is a transactional/marketplace/fintech/e-commerce/SaaS app where logic flaws produce direct financial impact.

copy.tagline: 检测业务逻辑漏洞，防止被利用造成经济损失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责安全测试且应用涉及交易、支付或订阅等业务逻辑。
copy.tagline_en: Detect business logic flaws to prevent financial exploitation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you perform security testing on transactional or fintech applications.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你测试业务逻辑漏洞，包括工作流绕过、价格操纵、优惠券滥用、竞争条件等，并帮助构建攻击链。
howto.when: 当你在完成基础 OWASP Top 10 测试后，或针对交易、市场、金融、电商、SaaS 类应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个电商应用的优惠券叠加漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会指导你发送多个优惠券请求并检查是否可叠加。

say.text: 检查这个支付流程是否存在竞争条件。
say.note: Claude 会建议并行发送请求并观察状态变化。

say.text: 尝试绕过这个多步骤结账流程中的支付步骤。
say.note: Claude 会指导你直接调用确认接口跳过支付。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you in testing business logic vulnerabilities, including workflow bypass, price manipulation, coupon abuse, race conditions, and helps build attack chains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have covered basic OWASP Top 10 testing, or when the target is a transactional, marketplace, fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS application.

say_en.text: Help me test coupon stacking on this e-commerce app.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to send multiple coupon requests and check for stacking.

say_en.text: Check this payment flow for race conditions.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest sending parallel requests and observing state changes.

say_en.text: Try to bypass the payment step in this multi-step checkout.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to directly call the confirm endpoint to skip payment.
